purpose: Whether the skill is consulted at all, which is separate from whether it helps once consulted. Measured because the treatment engaged in none of seven runs on a repository that does not already carry this skill's artifacts, while engaging in both runs on one that does.

scoring.trigger: The skill should be consulted. Scored as recall.
scoring.no-trigger: The skill should not be consulted. Scored as precision. These are near misses that share vocabulary with the skill's domain but ask for no change to this repository; an obviously unrelated query is a free pass and measures nothing.
scoring.unscored: Recorded but not scored, because the project has not decided the case. The router says not to create a change record 'merely because this skill was invoked', which presumes invocation may happen and asks for restraint afterwards. Counting an undecided case as a failure would be scoring an ambiguity.

split: Stratified by label, assigned here rather than computed, so that it cannot drift between runs. The description is revised against train only; test is measured once at the end and its score is optimistically biased by that selection.
